_help: Reel scout settings. Each series has its own hashtags, creators to always include, and the kind of idea we want back. Budget: Apify free plan is $5/month (about 1,900 results). Each run spends up to max_results_per_run, scouting the series that were scouted longest ago first, so all series rotate through.

kiro.name: Kiro buzz reels
kiro.about: The AI Gurukul: fast 'buzz' reels with numbered steps teaching AWS Kiro (an agentic IDE: specs, hooks, steering, agent chat) to Indian developers, in English and Hinglish.
kiro.idea: a Kiro buzz reel: hook line (max 12 words), on-screen text, 3 beats

claude.name: Claude buzz reels
claude.about: The AI Gurukul: fast 'buzz' reels showing one Claude feature each (Projects, Artifacts, Memory, Skills, Research, Claude Code), screen-recorded, for Indian professionals, in English.
claude.idea: a Claude feature reel: hook line (max 12 words), on-screen text, 3 beats

vidya.name: Vidya daily reels
vidya.about: Vidya: a friendly, openly AI-generated Indian woman host (teal blazer, round teal glasses, bright home office) who shows everyday people one practical AI trick a day (decode a bill, fix an email, plan a week), alternating natural English and polished Hinglish, 15-20 seconds, made from 6-second Veo clips plus screen cards.
vidya.idea: a Vidya reel: her first spoken line (max 12 words), the everyday problem, the Claude trick, on-screen text

mira.name: WTF Claude (Mira)
mira.about: WTF Claude: a sister channel where Mira, an openly AI host with a sharp, deadpan, slightly sarcastic style (leather jacket, neon studio), explains one Claude feature in 20-30 seconds with a 'WTF' hook in the first 3 seconds and a real screen demo. English with light Hinglish punch lines.
mira.idea: a Mira 'WTF' reel: deadpan first line (max 10 words), on-screen hook (4-7 words), the WTF analogy, the payoff line

mishti.name: Mishti emotions
mishti.about: Mishti: a silent, original chibi cartoon girl (pastel pink kurta crop top, pigtail buns with yellow scrunchies, small green parrot) in 6-8 second loopable reels, one relatable feeling each, with hook text in the first 2 seconds (Hinglish or English) and a famous Hindi song picked to match the mood.
mishti.idea: a Mishti reel: the emotion, hook text (3-8 words), the one-action scene, the loop ending, and the song mood (describe the vibe; don't name a specific song unless it is in the reel)
